annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/947 of 24 May 2019 on the rules and procedures for the operation of unmanned aircraft (UK retained/amended version)
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/947 of 24 May 2019 on the rules and procedures for the operation of unmanned aircraft (UK retained/amended version)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission; as amended and published by King's Printer (legislation.gov.uk), UK
annotation.summary_en: Consolidated text of Implementing Regulation 2019/947 on unmanned aircraft operations, as retained and amended in UK law (latest amendments 2025–2026). It sets a risk-proportionate framework of open, specific and certified categories, with operator registration, remote pilot competency, risk assessment, authorisations and geographical zones.
key_provisions_or_claims: Three operation categories: open, specific, certified, scaled to risk
Open category subdivided A1/A2/A3 with distances, pilot competency and UAS class requirements
Specific category requires operational risk assessment and CAA authorisation or LUC
Operators must register if UAS ≥250 g, ≥80 J impact energy, or camera-equipped ≥100 g; remote ID and geo-awareness
CAA oversees, handles incident reporting; Secretary of State may designate geographical zones
